data.one_liner: A simple slide-to-action widget for Flutter inspired by Android Slide To Act.
data.what_it_does: Provides a customizable slide-to-unlock/action widget that adapts to your theme. Allows handling user sliding actions with animations and text customization.
use_when: You need a slide-to-unlock or slide-to-confirm pattern in your app
You want a customizable slider widget that adapts to the app theme
avoid_when: You need standard buttons or switches instead of a sliding action
You require complex state management solutions
strengths: Includes rotation and text style customization
weaknesses: Very narrow and specific use case
Limited documentation of advanced properties in the README
